ImageDescription.value:
Photograph of group including Geo G Paul (standing, left), Tupu Taingakawa (seated, centre), Mita Karaka (standing, right) and Te Rata Mahuta (seated, right) taken by an unknown photogrpaher around the time that the four men went to England to petition King george V to return confiscated Waikato land. 
(File has been corrected to subdue the mesh effect over the image.)
